title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Maybe think of something or a way where you can get tributes from fans. Like their Al Kaline memories, etc. Almost like a virtual guestbook at someone’s funeral kinda thing
The guestbook-funeral sounds kinda cold, but that’s just a way of explaining it
Yeah, already pitched an email address where they could send memories. That’s good I’m not alone in that thinking. Especially since we can’t really hold a public funeral
